svg.text: PlasRisk: A Multi-Dimension Data-Driven Weighted Risk Assessment Framework for Bacterial Plasmids
(A) Data-driven weight determination · (B) Command-line risk scoring · (C) Dimensionality analysis & lite mode
Consensus of RF-MDG + LASSO + Entropy + Grid
Lite mode (--mode lite): S_ARG + S_VF + S_MOB + S_SIZE + S_BM
Equivalent mean AUC to full model (0.920 vs 0.920)
Replicon prior lookup: 66 typed replicons with pre-computed S_REP / S_GEO / S_HAB / S_GROW / S_HOST
Unknown replicons → neutral defaults (0.30); prefix matching handles subtypes (IncFII(K) → IncFII).
C. Dimensionality analysis & PlasRisk-lite (all-subsets, 1,023 models, 5-fold CV)
● Plateau at k=5: mean AUC = 0.920 (same as full)
Mean CV AUC vs. number of dimensions (plateau at k=5):
→ Pareto optimality: 10-dim is non-dominated across all 4 outcomes;
the 5 context dimensions (HOST, REP, GEO, HAB, GROW) add epidemiological value
for One Health surveillance even though they contribute <0.1% to mean AUC.
→ No overfitting: train-test gap <0.003, bootstrap optimism <0.005.
→ Both modes offered: full for surveillance, lite for rapid screening.
● Requires ARG + VFDB + mobility genes + length + BacMet (no metadata priors)
● Mean AUC = 0.920, equivalent to full 10-dim model; S_VF raises fusion AUC to 0.963
● Ideal for resource-limited settings, large-scale screening, One Health surveillance
